description: Returns the signed-in account's selected wedding details, including partner names, date, location and venue, the city and country picked in settings, and the destination to pass to the budget and guest travel estimates for the wedding's own place. Access is limited to weddings the account can manage.

wedding_id.description: Identifier of a wedding the signed-in account can manage. Required when the account has multiple weddings.

name: get_my_wedding
title: Get My Wedding Details
